announcements.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
announcements.snippet: We’re expanding our ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to our frontier models.

announcements.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
announcements.snippet: New tools, practical guidance, and partnerships will help prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse.

announcements.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
announcements.snippet: Explore how more than 1,800 scientists use ChatGPT in research. See findings on daily workflows, reported productivity, and expectations for discovery.

announcements.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
announcements.snippet: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

announcements.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
announcements.snippet: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

announcements.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
announcements.snippet: Introducing computer-use agents, improved clinical answers, and new healthcare plugins that work across healthcare software to get real work done.

announcements.title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
announcements.snippet: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.

announcements.title: At Holiday Extras, dots get to work before anyone asks
announcements.snippet: Dots deliver launch reports unprompted, flag issues people might miss, and talk through upcoming meetings on the commute to work.

announcements.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
announcements.snippet: Explore a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model and how GPT-6 Astra helped turn the idea into a detailed proof.

announcements.title: Our new blog for science
announcements.snippet: The OpenAI science blog shares new findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.
